```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a violin plot to visualize transaction amounts by fraud status
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.violinplot(x='is_fraud', y='amount', data=data, hue='transaction_type', split=True, inner='quartile')

# Set the title and labels
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts by Fraud Status and Type', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Fraud Status (0 = No Fraud, 1 = Fraud)', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(ticks=[0, 1], labels=['No Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
